author: Subscriptor
body:
Yes, I took this idea from other server, but it's so damn great and fun.
Its nebula sub gamemode, don't have a name in my mind yet.

The game:
You spawn on certain team with gear already there like normal nebula loadout, and in a specific map. Every team has one (preferred) to two monuments, the other teams need to break it, but here comes the cool thing. The teams can respond as long as they have their monument alive, once it's broken, they cannot respawn anymore,cans the other teams need to kill them in order to completely eliminate the team from the match and they will turn into spectators.
There can be 1-8 teams preferable, comes with lower amount of players per team with the high number of teams, and low amount of teams with more player capacity, depends on the map. The map doesn't need to have bedrock, some maps will be with bedrock to allow tunneling, some will be without bedrock and you will not be able to break blocks from the original Mao, only place. Ew blocks and break them. Teams get credits on the place they got, for example, yellow team survived last, 150 credits, then green second place, 100 credits and so on. Normal credit values for monument break and kill, however final kill (when the monument is broken) should double the amount of credits for this kill. For example for the maps, there could be really little and small maps, I mean 16 players, 8 teams, 2 players per team, could play well. This should have a rotation for itself and added to mix as well if it gets accepted. Please suggest name and other feedback or ideas below.
